description: Impairment testing: goodwill impairment and intangible impairment under US GAAP (ASC 350) or IFRS (IAS 36). Method selects the formula. Use for annual or triggering-event impairment testing; goodwill_impairment compares a reporting unit's carrying value with its fair value. To compute the initial goodwill or allocation use valuation_goodwill_ppa; for the underlying asset fair values use the relevant asset-type tool. Per method: goodwill_impairment needs carrying_value + fair_value (optional: reporting_unit, standard, value_in_use, costs_to_sell); intangible_impairment needs carrying_value (optional: fair_value, recoverable_amount, standard); value_in_use needs cash_flow_projections + terminal_growth_rate + discount_rate; fair_value_less_costs needs fair_value (optional: disposal_costs, costs_to_sell); cgu_impairment needs cgu_carrying_value + cgu_recoverable_amount + goodwill_allocated + other_assets. intangible_impairment: fair_value is required for ASC350, recoverable_amount for IAS36. goodwill_impairment takes fair_value under either standard and ignores recoverable_amount; its IAS 36 inputs are value_in_use and costs_to_sell. fair_value_less_costs takes exactly one of disposal_costs or costs_to_sell. Only method is required; all other parameters are method-dependent — supply those the selected method names and omit the rest (defaults apply where defined). Rates and premiums are decimals (0.10 = 10%). Pure arithmetic: no I/O and no external calls; values carry the library's own precision (rates are decimals, so a royalty rate of 0.055 is not rounded); parameters belonging to other methods are accepted and ignored. An unknown method, or a missing method-required parameter, returns an error instead of a value.

carrying_value.description: Carrying value of the reporting unit or asset, in currency units.

cash_flow_projections.description: Projected after-tax cash flows per period t=1..n, in currency units.

cgu_carrying_value.description: Carrying value of the cash-generating unit, in currency units.

cgu_recoverable_amount.description: Recoverable amount of the cash-generating unit, in currency units.

costs_to_sell.description: IAS 36 costs to sell, deducted from fair value. Default 0.

discount_rate.description: Per-period discount rate as a decimal (0.10 = 10%).

disposal_costs.description: Costs of disposal, in currency units.

fair_value.description: Fair value of the reporting unit or asset, in currency units.

goodwill_allocated.description: Goodwill allocated to the cash-generating unit, in currency units.

method.description: Formula to apply. Options: goodwill_impairment = Impairment = max(0, carrying value - recoverable amount). IAS 36: recoverable amount is the HIGHER of fair value less costs to sell and value in use.; intangible_impairment = Impairment of an intangible under ASC 350 or IAS 36.; value_in_use = IAS 36 value in use from discounted cash flows.; fair_value_less_costs = IAS 36 fair value less costs of disposal.; cgu_impairment = IAS 36 impairment loss allocated at the cash-generating-unit level.

other_assets.description: Other assets as JSON objects with `name` and `carrying_value`; at least one is required.

standard.description: Accounting standard: ASC350 for US GAAP, IAS36 for IFRS.

terminal_growth_rate.description: Perpetual growth applied after the projections, as a decimal (0.02 = 2%).

value_in_use.description: IAS 36 value in use, in currency units. Recoverable amount is the higher of this and fair value less costs to sell.

name: valuation_impairment

assumptions.description: Modelling assumptions applied (list of strings or key/value object).

defaults_applied.description: Optional parameters that were not supplied, so their documented defaults were used.

error.description: Error message when the call fails.

method.description: Formula / method name that produced the result.

steps.description: Intermediate calculation steps for traceability (one string per step).

title: Impairment Testing
